content.en: The **Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO)** is a specialized agency of the United Nations. It serves as a neutral forum where nations meet to negotiate agreements and debate policy. Its primary objective is to achieve **food security** for all and ensure that people have regular access to enough high-quality food to lead active, healthy lives.

definition.en: FAO acts as a knowledge network, providing data and technical expertise to member countries.

content.en: The FAO monitors global food prices and agricultural production to prevent crises.

content.en: Do not confuse FAO with the World Food Programme (WFP); while they collaborate, they have distinct mandates.
